Maya (CEO): Quick follow-up thread from todays all-hands focused on positioning and the one-page narrative. Drop short Qs and we'll answer.

Priya (Head of Product): Should product pages lead with developer DX or enterprise controls?

Maya (CEO): Lead with developer DX for PLG; include a clear enterprise line underneath: Private + KMS + SLA.

Nora (Marketing): Need a single sentence for the website hero that isn't too technical. Any options?

Maya (CEO): Draft: 'Make model features dependable: predictable latency, lower cost, and flexible deployment.' Shorten for hero as needed.

Jon (CTO): For demos, always surface numbers: median latency and cost per 1k tokens. Customers trust concrete metrics.

Rashid (Field Eng): Field ask: prospects ask about cost spikes during bursts. Approved short answer?

Jon (CTO): "We smooth bursts with adaptive batching, prefix caching, and policy-driven routing". Point to published conservative benchmarks if pressed.

Sam (Sales): Sales trigger check: what moves a trial to an AE? We need a crisp rule.

Priya (Head of Product): Proposed rule: sustained >$5k/mo, explicit Private/KMS ask, or 3 p95 breaches in a week. I'll add to the playbook.

Nora (Marketing): Can Legal pre-clear two conservative stats we can publish?

Maya (CEO): Proposed safe lines: 'median request latency ~100ms for common decoder models' and 'typical TCO improvements ~30% vs unmanaged fleets'  tag as illustrative until sign-off.

StabilityBot: Canary finished in us-east-1 at 14:12 UTC. Logs: https://internal.redwood/canary/2345600000

Maya (CEO): Thanks everyone. Priya will post the playbook and Jon will upload two demo YAML snippets to the Sales folder. If no more Qs, Ill close this thread EOD. :raised_hands:
